description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class 'Latest' for the OpenCart admin extension module, handling display and save operations for the 'Latest' module settings in the admin interface.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'Latest' module settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the module configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, retrieving module info if editing, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save or update the 'Latest' module settings, handles validation, and responds with JSON.
